shifts.note: Shouting is rarely urgent in training. A robust model should barely move.

shifts.note: Control for the row above: the same extra length, no urgency word.

shifts.name: A quarter of non-urgent requesters copy an impact phrase
shifts.note: They append "My whole team has the same problem." to get faster service. Labels stay non-urgent.

shifts.note: The real unseen channel. Small sample, so read with care.
